# certloom_issuer (Data Source)

Looks up an ACME issuer by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "certloom_issuer" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `directory_url` (String) ACME directory URL.
- `eab_mode` (String) External Account Binding mode.
- `id` (String) Identifier.
